dataify-google-hotels v1.0.0

- Initial release of the dataify-google-hotels skill.
- Converts user hotel price/availability requests into Dataify Scraper API form posts.
- Adds a step-by-step parameter confirmation workflow, including a Markdown table of all API parameters before every API call.
- Ensures users confirm or modify all relevant parameters before proceeding, and requires explicit user confirmation.
- Handles token requirements, prompting users to sign in if necessary.
- Passes hotel queries, dates, and other parameters to the underlying scripts and returns the API response directly without modification.
